newsitem.title: USA: PacificAmerica to sell $750 MLN in loans.
newsitem.headline: PacificAmerica to sell $750 MLN in loans.

text.p: PacificAmerica Money Center Inc (PAMM) said on Tuesday it has amended and expanded its loan sale and securitization agreement with Advanta Mortgage Conduit Inc and Advanta Mortgage USA Inc.
PAMM has committed to sell a minimum of $750 million in new loans over a three-year period beginning June 1.
PAMM has already sold more than $315 million of loans to Advanta since December 1996, exceeding the original $200 million commitment.

The amended agreement also provides a reduction in the sponsor fee PAMM pays to Advanta for all loans sold for securitization, a reduction in the amount of the cash advance Advanta provides to PAMM for its excess spread on each securitization pool and an increase in the interest rate on cash advances.

Joel Schultz, president and chief executive officer of PAMM, said in a statement, "We are very pleased to expand our sale and securitization program with Advanta. We believe that the modified terms of our agreement with Advanta will allow PAMM to significantly improve its net profit margins on loans sold for securitization."
